description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans silo metadata functionality, including configuration, retrieval, synchronization, and handling of metadata across silo clusters.

classes.name: SiloMetadataTests
classes.description: Contains test methods for validating the behavior of silo metadata configuration, updates, and cluster synchronization.

classes.name: SiloMetadataTests.Fixture
classes.description: Manages setup and teardown of an in-memory test cluster for the silo metadata tests.

methods.name: SiloMetadata_FromConfiguration_CanBeSetAndRead
methods.description: Verifies that silo metadata configured via application configuration can be retrieved correctly from the cluster.

methods.name: SiloMetadata_HasConfiguredValues
methods.description: Checks that the configured metadata values are present and correctly stored in the silo metadata cache.

methods.name: SiloMetadata_CanBeSetAndRead
methods.description: Asserts that the silo metadata can be set and read across all silos in the cluster.

methods.name: SiloMetadata_NewSilosHaveMetadata
methods.description: Verifies that new silos added to the cluster have initialized metadata.

methods.name: SiloMetadata_RemovedSiloHasNoMetadata
methods.description: Checks that when a silo is stopped, its metadata is cleared or unavailable.

methods.name: SiloMetadata_BadSiloAddressHasNoMetadata
methods.description: Confirms that querying metadata for an invalid/sentinel silo address returns empty metadata.

methods.name: AssertAllSiloMetadataMatchesOnAllSilos
methods.description: Extension method to assert that all silos in the cluster have consistent metadata for a set of expected keys.
